title: Technician II Plant Health and Biosecurity Investigation Log
description: A scouting and investigation record for symptom distribution, direct pest or pathogen signs, abiotic alternatives, containment actions, sampling, confirmation status, and escalation.
instructions: Record symptom pattern and direct signs separately from the suspected cause.
Document affected and unaffected comparison areas, chronology, crop stage, and recent environmental or cultural changes.
Use site biosecurity procedures when collecting, containing, moving, or submitting suspect material.
Record confirmation status and who owns the next containment, treatment, sampling, or disposition decision.
limitations: Visual similarity alone does not confirm a pest, pathogen, viroid, nutrient disorder, or environmental injury.
Pesticide selection, disease disposition, quarantine, and destructive actions require the applicable legal, label, site, and supervisory authority.
publicationNote: Owner-approved academic learner support. Not a regulated record, facility SOP, assessor score sheet, or professional credential issuance instrument.
